seo.title: About Alsharq | Our Story, Vision & Values
seo.description: Learn about Alsharq Bilingual Private School's story, vision, mission, educational values, and why bilingual education matters.

hero.title: The story of a school that builds generations
hero.subtitle: Since its founding, Alsharq has aimed to be a second home that combines Arabic authenticity with openness to the world.

story.title: A journey from passion to excellence
paragraphs: Alsharq Bilingual Private School for Boys was founded on a firm belief: real education starts with a safe environment that respects a student's identity while opening the world to them at the same time.

Over more than fifteen years, we've built a complete educational system that combines the rigor of the Iraqi curriculum with the openness of international educational standards, graduating generations confident in their identity and ready for their future.

Today, Alsharq continues to develop its academic and technology programs to stay at the forefront of private schools in Baghdad, trusted by hundreds of families who chose us as a partner in their sons' educational journey.

visionMission.visionBody: To be Baghdad's leading private school in preparing a bilingual generation — academically and digitally capable, and able to compete locally and globally.
visionMission.missionBody: We deliver a balanced education that combines Arabic and English, builds 21st-century skills, within a safe environment that embraces every student and believes in their unique abilities.

seo.title: Admissions | Alsharq School
seo.description: Registration requirements and steps, tuition fees, the online application form, and frequently asked questions about admission at Alsharq.

hero.title: Your first step toward Alsharq
hero.subtitle: Everything you need to know about registration requirements, steps, and fees at Alsharq Bilingual Private School for Boys.

requirements.title: Required documents
requirements.subtitle: Please have the following documents ready when submitting your application.

items.title: Registration application form
items.description: Complete the online or paper registration form in full.

items.title: Birth certificate copy
items.description: A clear, certified copy of the student's birth certificate.

items.title: Previous school record
items.description: Transcript or report card from the previous academic year.

items.title: Personal photos
items.description: Four recent passport-style photos of the student.

items.title: Parent ID copy
items.description: A copy of the parent's national ID or passport.

steps.title: From application to enrollment
steps.subtitle: A clear, straightforward registration process in four steps.

items.title: Submit the online application
items.description: Fill in the registration form on the site; our admissions team will reach out within 24 hours.

items.title: Document review
items.description: The admissions team reviews the submitted documents and confirms eligibility.

items.title: Introductory meeting & assessment
items.description: A short meeting with student and parent to understand the student's academic level.

items.title: Confirm registration
items.description: Complete payment procedures and confirm the student's seat for the academic year.

fees.title: Flexible fees to suit every family
fees.body: Tuition fees vary by grade level, and convenient installment plans are available. Contact us for the full fee details for your son's academic year.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Reach us directly on WhatsApp or via the Contact page.

items.question: What's the right age to register my son?
items.answer: Alsharq accepts students from Grade 7 through Grade 12, matched to the appropriate age for each grade.

items.question: Can a student transferring from another school be admitted?
items.answer: Yes, we accept transfer students at every grade level, after reviewing their previous academic record.

items.question: Is the school uniform mandatory?
items.answer: Yes, the school uniform is mandatory for all students, to maintain identity and school discipline.

items.question: Is school transport available?
items.answer: Yes, the school offers a transport service covering most areas of Baghdad for an additional fee.

items.question: Are there sibling discounts?
items.answer: Yes, the school offers a special discount when registering more than one son from the same family. Contact us for details.
